item.title: Whitecourt man charged with drug and firearm offences after Spruce Grove traffic stop

item.title: Whitecourt Wolverines hockey team wins the AJHL 2025–26 regular season title
item.description: The Whitecourt Wolverines are going into the 2026 Inter Pipeline Cup AJHL Playoffs after securing this year’s regular season title, according to the Alberta Junior Hockey League (AJHL). The Wolverines snagged the Dave Duchak Trophy and became the 2025–26 regular season champions, marking the second time the Whitecourt team won the league title since the 2023–24 season. […]
